card.name: On after stand, culture, grown; tazobactam start
card.fires_on: The word "on" (or "of") after verbs like stand, culture, or grown, describing a surface or medium. Also the start of "tazobactam" after "piperacillin and".

modes.label: On a surface or medium
modes.description: The word "on" or "of" after stand, culture, grown or surface, introducing where something rests or grows.
modes.example: Allow the reconstituted vials to stand<< on>> the table for 5 – 1

modes.label: Start of tazobactam
modes.description: The first letter or the word "and" just before "tazobactam" in piperacillin-tazobactam text.
modes.example: CAUTIONS Serious hypersensitivity reactions (anaphylactic/anaphylactoid) reactions have been reported in patients receiving piperacillin and<< t>>azobactam.
